up: Retrieve the canonical SMILES strings for all unique compounds that have been tested in assays targeting the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (target CHEMBL224) where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Ensure the results are distinct by molecule.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL224' AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
